messages:
kelly ng: Heads up — Arjun Mehta is visiting Tue 2026-07-14. Flight lands SFO 08:10. Hes booked for a hybrid day: morning panels remote, afternoon onsite for hands-on. Need lobby pickup, desk reservation, VPN access, and a loaner with M1 Mac if possible.
omar reyes: I can meet him at the curb at 12:00 and bring a printed visitor pass. Can the hands-on be 13:30-15:00 to give me time?
sam lee: 13:30 works for me. Can we confirm the hands-on repo will be pre-cloned and that internet access is allowed? Also candidate prefers a standing desk.
recruiter-bot: Calendar invite created: 2026-07-14T09:00:00-07:00 to 2026-07-14T16:00:00-07:00. Panels: Remote intro 09:00-09:30, System 10:00-11:00, Lunch, Onsite hands-on 13:30-15:00. Remote fallback included.
facilities-bot: Standing desk reserved at Hotdesk P2-04 for 13:00-16:00. Visitor pass printing available at lobby. ADA note: none.
kelly ng: Candidate is vegetarian and lactose-intolerant. Please arrange boxed lunch labeled. Also asked whether we can provide a quiet room between panels.
it-bot: IT note: VPN account provisioning takes ~30m. Submit request here -> https://redwood.internal/it/vpn with candidate name and email. Loaner request: MacBook Air M1, install repo and VPN profile, setup account for local login.
omar reyes: @it-bot can you pre-provision a temporary VPN token and guest workstation so Arjun can sign in without waiting? Hes remote in the morning and will need to push code during the onsite.
it-bot: Confirmed: temporary VPN token will be in an envelope at the front desk under "Arjun Mehta". Loaner LB-M1-220 assigned and pre-cloned with repo 'github.com/redwood/hiring-kit'. Charger included.
sam lee: Perfect. Can someone add parking instructions? He asked whether we validate ride-share receipts.
kelly ng: Parking: visitor lot C, bring pass. Expense: ride-share under $60 auto-approve; longer stays need expense form. I'll attach the simple expense guide to the invite.
recruiter-bot: Reminder: add remote-highlights note in invite: "If delayed, panels run fully remote; hands-on can proceed remote if candidate prefers."
omar reyes: One more: please make sure his work account email is whitelisted for our internal github org so he can fork the task repo if needed.
it-bot: Github access: added temporary collaborator access for arjun.m@example.com expiring 48h after visit.
kelly ng: Thanks team. I'll DM Arjun the pickup details and send the boxed lunch request to catering. Anyone object to this schedule?
sam lee: All good from me.
omar reyes: Good to go. I'll be at the lobby at noon. :wave:
